name: CopyExcelWorksheetToDataTable
label: Copy Range from Excel Worksheet to DataTable
description: Copies a specified range of cells from the provided Excel worksheet into a DataTable.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which the data will be copied.

fields.name: RangeToCopy
fields.label: Range to Copy
fields.description: The range of cells to copy (e.g., 'A1:B10').

fields.name: HasHeaders
fields.label: Has Headers
fields.description: Indicates whether the first row contains column headers.

fields.name: CopiedData
fields.label: Copied Data
fields.description: Returns the copied data as a DataTable for further processing.
